}}'''Pylar''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Pylar}}

==History==
She is strong with [[Earth]].

==Activities==
As the [[Last Battle]] rages on the border between [[Kandor]] and [[Arafel]], Pylar fight alongside the [[Amyrlin Seat]], [[Egwene al'Vere]].

Her status following the Last Battle is unknown, but she is assumed alive.

== Trivia ==
* Pylar is named for a fan of ''The Wheel of Time'' named Jessica Christenberry, whose username was Pylar Al'Stnap.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
